generation_cohort.gray_constant_reuse: Within condition only: identical RGB bytes, shape, exact feedback text, prompt, seed and policy allow canonical-state reuse; all logical cases and provenance retained.

rollout.tool: actual scene_classify, registered tool calls only, role-separated feedback
rollout.state: same last valid decoding-step final-layer final-position hidden tensor is cached and passed to frozen scorer; no terminal forward-state replacement
rollout.quality: nonempty completed answer, no generated result tags, no mixed/unknown tool calls, no addCriterion, no token-limit or round-limit; failures retained
rollout.format_reward: 0.2 exactly when new rollout quality passes, otherwise 0.0; stricter than historical regex-only bonus
rollout.sampling_distribution: untruncated categorical softmax; first-token EOS suppression from min_new_tokens=1 is identically applied in policy logprob
rollout.tool_boundary_stop: complete scene_classify closing tag only; answers end on native configured EOS

mask: RGB(127,127,127), preserve original dimensions, Agent input only; retrieval backbone keeps real images
feedback: Replay exact recorded real-image scene_classify text/confidence on model requests; constant arm replaces this by fixed training image102.tif recorded feedback; no tool call is forced. Log observed feedback rounds.
frozen_readout_selection: all four previous val-selected checkpoints; SHA copied before diagnosis

permutations.method: independent seeded uniform random permutations, rejecting all with any fixed point; one complete permutation per full train1680 and val210 split, preserve multiset; all 20 reported

quantity.source: unchanged original cases and 56 candidate texts
quantity.primary: B hard-correct counts1to4 macro; A and all pair metrics retained

uncertainty.unit: paired image clusters; all five captions together; fixed gallery
uncertainty.permutation_summary: all20 individual deltas plus mean-delta paired image bootstrap; permutation spread kept separate from sampling interval
uncertainty.factorial_contrasts: example removed, gray image, constant feedback: paired factor changes averaged over the other two factors; also simple effects at real-image/real-feedback/with-example baseline
uncertainty.scope: single frozen Agent/readout seed, train/val diagnostic, no new model selection

report_node: all generation-factor controls +20 distribution-preserving permutations + frozen readout path/quantity/retrieval evidence, dual verification/backups and GitHub
